members.assessment: Named Sun Xiu belongs to Lun’s usurpation faction, captured and executed when Hui is restored; the two sons and Lun patron relation remain distinct and preserved.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 辛酉，左衛將軍王輿與尚書、淮陵王漼勒兵入宮，禽倫黨孫秀、孫會、許超、士猗、駱休等，皆斬之。
近不能開明刑威，式遏姦宄，至使逆臣孫秀敢肆凶虐，窺間王室，遂奉趙王倫饕據天位。
尚書漼共立大謀，左衛將軍王輿與群公卿士，協同謀略，親勒本營，斬秀及其二子。
前趙王倫爲秀所誤，與其子等已詣金墉迎朕幽宮，旋軫閶闔。

members.assessment: Sun Xiu is paired with Zhang Lin taking power after the Minhuai mulberry omen. The matching Song032 passage and the Lun/prince episode identify the adviser; incomplete idiomatic English is excluded as proof.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 是後孫秀、張林用事，遂至大亂。

members.assessment: Sun Xiu and Zhao Prince Lun jointly remove Jia after the deposed-prince plot, matching Jin053 and ZZT083 in action and patron.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 及太子廢黜，趙王倫、孫秀等因眾怨謀欲廢后[8]。

members.assessment: The adviser engineers the Yang empress installation through friendship with maternal grandfather Sun Qi, matching ZZT083s0354. Printed 太安元年 is disclosed as a separate chronology textual discrepancy, not repaired or used to multiply the person.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 賈后既廢，孫秀議立后。
后外祖孫旂與秀合族，又諸子自結於秀，故以太安元年立為皇后[9]。

members.assessment: The named Sun Xiu participates with Yiyang Prince Wei in preparing Lun’s usurpation ceremonies; the surrounding Fu Zhi story distinguishes its subject from the named conspirator.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 初，倫之篡也，孫秀與義陽王威等十餘人預撰儀式禪文。

members.assessment: Explicit Lun strategist in the Sima Ya/Xu Chao proposal and delayed prince-restoration speeches. All anaphoric Xiu references stay with that adviser; Sun Lü and the prince’s jailers remain different people.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 右衛督司馬雅，宗室之疏屬也，與常從督許超並有寵于太子，二人深傷之，說趙王倫謀臣孫秀曰：「國無適嗣，社稷將危，大臣之禍必起。
秀言于趙王倫，倫深納焉。
計既定，而秀說倫曰：「太子為人剛猛，若得志之日，必肆其情性矣。
明公素事賈后，街談巷議，皆以公為賈氏之黨。
今雖欲建大功于太子，太子雖將含忍宿忿，必不能加賞於公，當謂公逼百姓之望，翻覆以免罪耳。
若有瑕釁，猶不免誅。
不若遷延卻期，賈后必害太子，然後廢賈后，為太子報仇，猶足以為功，乃可以得志。」
秀因使反間，言殿中人欲廢賈后，迎太子。

members.assessment: The retrospective merit discussion calls Sun Xiu a traitor and contrasts the restoration of Hui after three princes rose, expressly the same Lun usurpation sequence.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 初，趙王倫篡位，三王起義，制《己亥格》，其後論功雖小，亦皆依用。
昔孫秀口唱篡逆，手弄天機，惠皇失禦，九服無戴。

members.assessment: Named Sun Xiu and Zhang Lin taking power fulfill the same Minhuai mulberry omen as Jin028, a distinctive shared historical retrospective. His name label and relation to the Zhang Lin record remain as supplied.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 是後孫秀、張林尋用事，遂至大亂。

members.assessment: The memorial recalls former Grand Commandant Chen Huai supporting Sun Xiu and harm reaching Huainan in the prior Western court, contrasted with the restoration. The later memorial date is a quotation frame, not a new lifespan for Sun Xiu.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 故太尉廣陵公陳淮，黨翼孫秀，禍加淮南，竊饗大國，因罪為利。

members.assessment: Lun’s adviser refuses the proposal to restore the prince immediately, shapes the Jia-removal strategy and uses forged letters, matching the detailed Jin053 sequence.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 乃說孫秀曰：「中宮凶妒無道，與賈謐等共誣廢太子。
秀許諾，言於倫，倫納焉，遂告通事令史張林及省事張衡等，使為內應。
事將起，孫秀言於倫曰：「太子聰明剛猛，若還東宮，必不受制於人。
秀因使人行反間，言殿中人欲廢皇后，迎太子。
倫、秀因勸謐等早除太子，以絕眾望。
趙王倫、孫秀將討賈后，告右衛佽飛督閭和，和從之，期以癸巳丙夜一籌，以鼓聲為應。
癸巳，秀使司馬雅告張華曰：「趙王欲與公共匡社稷，為天下除害，使雅以告。」
倫陰與秀謀篡位，欲先除朝望，且報宿怨，乃執張華、裴頠、解系、解結等於殿前。

members.assessment: Continuous sequel after Jia’s fall: Sun Xiu controls Lun’s decisions and receives office in the same patronage faction. No intervening introduction establishes another Sun Xiu.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 孫秀等皆封大郡，並據兵權，文武官封侯者數千人，百官總己以聽於倫。
倫素庸愚，復受制於孫秀。
秀為中書令，威權振朝廷，天下皆事秀而無求於倫。

members.assessment: Sun Xiu engineers events through Sima Yun’s revolt, Pan Yue/Shi Chong revenge, Nine Bestowals and Lun’s usurpation. His own son Sun Hui and Lun’s sons are separately represented; the Pan Yue flogging passage is read from Chinese, not the reversed idiomatic agent.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 允知相國倫及孫秀有異志，陰養死士，謀討之；
倫、秀深憚之。
秀遣御史劉機逼允，收其官屬以下，劾以拒詔，大逆不敬。
允視詔，乃秀手書也，大怒，收御史，將斬之，御史走免，斬其令史二人。
初，孫秀嘗為小吏，事黃門郎潘岳，岳屢撻之。
衛尉石崇之甥歐陽建素與相國倫有隙，崇有愛妾曰綠珠，孫秀便求之，崇不與。
及淮南王允敗，秀因稱石崇、潘岳、歐陽建奉允為亂，收之。
孫秀覺之，且憚其在內，乃出為平東將軍，鎮許昌。
孫秀議加相國倫九錫，百官莫敢異議。
孫秀曰：「殺張、裴已傷時望，不可復殺頌。」
又加孫秀侍中、輔國將軍，相國司馬、右率如故。
倫及諸子皆頑鄙無識，秀狡黠貪淫，所與共事者，皆邪佞之士，惟競榮利，無深謀遠略，志趣乖異，互相憎嫉。
秀子會為射聲校尉，形貌短陋，如奴僕之下者，秀使尚帝女河東公主。

members.assessment: s0354 explicitly names Sun Xiu, friend of the new empress’s grandfather Sun Qi, matching Jin031p240. s0386 instead refers to Li Xiang 李庠 appointed by Zhao Xin; its mistranslated English Xiu occurrence and c0283 evidence are foreign to this Sun Xiu and are excluded from identity proof, with exact defect disclosed.

primaryChineseQuotes.zh: 外祖平南將軍樂安孫旂，與孫秀善，故秀立之。
廞以庠為威寇將軍，封陽泉亭侯，委以心膂，使招合六郡壯勇至萬餘人，以斷北道。
